name: 特殊学生支持 · 语言能力较弱学生
description_zh: 为教师生成针对语言能力较弱学生（含跨语言儿童）的多维支持方案：课堂支持 + 作业调整 + 家校沟通 + IEP 个别化辅导计划；严守不诊断、不暴露隐私的红线。触发关键词：语言能力较弱、跨语言儿童、少数民族学生、随迁子女、普通话弱、汉语弱、特殊需要学生支持、个别化辅导计划、IEP。
description_en: Generates multi-dimensional support plans for teachers targeting students with weak language ability (including cross-language children): classroom support + homework adjustments + home-school communication + IEP individualized support plan; strictly upholds red lines of not diagnosing and not disclosing privacy. Trigger keywords: weak language ability, cross-language children, ethnic-minority students, migrant children, weak Mandarin, weak Chinese, special-needs student support, individualized education plan, IEP.
